buying a garment because it looks good in a photo vs. how it actually moves during a commute.

most people only dress for the camera.

we chose a slightly denser cotton for the new restock. 

it makes the piece feel like it’s actually made of something. 

people either love the weight or they hate it.

that one hoodie you’ve had for six years that’s finally starting to thin out at the elbows.

throw it away or keep it forever?
